Name: Kempinski Hotels
Company description: Founded in Germany in 1897, Kempinski Hotels has long reflected the finest traditions of European hospitality. Today, as ever, Kempinski is synonymous with distinctive luxury. Located in many of the world's most well-known cities and resorts, the Kempinski collection includes hotels in a grand manner, pace-setting modern establishments and older hotels of individual charm. All blend gracefully into their surroundings and offer luxurious accommodation, superb cuisine and unrivalled facilities - complemented by impeccable service. For leisure and business guests alike, the name Kempinski has long been synonymous with style, mobility and efficiency. Put simply, they are the first choice for the discerning individual. In addition to operating many of the finest city hotels in the world, Kempinski is a name that can now be found in many exciting resort locations, each combining local flair and ambience with the international standards of service and luxury that Kempinski guests have come to expect. To see all the different Kempinski jobs and apply please go to https://kempinski.jobs It is also possible to search and find the Kempinski jobs in LinkedIn's  "Jobs"​ section.

Name: Travel Charme Hotels & Resorts
Company description: Bright eyes. Vacation dreams. Favourite places. Travel Charme Hotels & Resorts, which the Hirmer Group took over in 2018, stands for unique experiences and genuine hospitality. The portfolio of the upscale holiday hotel expert currently includes eleven individual establishments: the Kurhaus Binz and the Nordperd & Villen Göhren on Rügen, the Strandhotel Bansin and the Strandidyll Heringsdorf on Usedom, the Ostseehotel Kühlungsborn, the Hotel Gothisches Haus in Wernigerode and the Bergresort Werfenweng in the Salzburg region, the Fürstenhaus on Lake Achensee in Tyrol, the Ifen Hotel in the Kleinwalsertal and also the Badeschloss and the Straubinger Grand Hotel in Bad Gastein. The individual hotels not only impress with their unique dreamy locations, they also inspire their guests with an unmistakable mixture of personal service, a pinch of adventure and a lot of passion.

Name: Event Hotels
Company description: Alle Infos zu Aktionen, Karriere, Datenschutz & Impressum sind im Shared Link aufzufinden ⬇️ Gut zu wissen: …unsere 59 Häuser verfügen in Summe über 9.993 Zimmer. …jene Hotels werden nicht nur über die beiden Zentralen in Köln, sondern auch von Berlin, Frankfurt, Amsterdam, Liechtenstein und Luxemburg aus gesteuert. …in allen zentralen Büros arbeiten derzeit über 200 Kolleg*innen. …und in allen Hotels aktuell mehr als 2.500 Mitarbeiter*innen. …wir beschreiben uns als fair, kreativ, modern, zuverlässig, aufgeschlossen und ambitioniert. Unsere Geschichte: Event Hotels fand seine Entstehung im Jahre 1992 und ist ein Gründer- und Inhabergeführtes Unternehmen. Anders Braks (CEO) übernahm zu jenem Zeitpunkt das erste Hotel und begründete damit die Erfolgsgeschichte der Event Hotels, denn mittlerweile werden durch Event Hotels 59 Häuser in Europa (Deutschland, Niederlande und Italien) betrieben. Innerhalb des Investment Rankings wird Event Hotels mit AA bewertet. Event Hotels ist spezialisiert auf die Akquisition, Verwaltung und den Verkauf von Investment-Grade-Hotels und Portfolios mit besonderer Expertise in den Bereichen Sourcing, Finanzierung, Hotelbetrieb, Sanierung, Raumplanung, Projektmanagement und Exit-Strukturierung. Mit der Bereitstellung aller notwendigen Ressourcen für diese Bereiche im eigenen Haus und der Konzentration auf das individuelle Management und den Erfolg jedes einzelnen Hotels ist Event Hotels heute ein einzigartiger Schlüsselspieler im wettbewerbsintensiven internationalen Hotelimmobilien-Investmentbereich.

Name: MHP Hotel AG
Company description: MHP Hotel AG, formerly known as Munich Hotel Partners GmbH, is an independent hotel investment and management platform headquartered in Munich, specializing in premium and luxury hotels. The company is dedicated to sustainability, integrating environmental protection, resource conservation, and climate neutrality into its operations, as demonstrated by the LEED O+M Platinum certification awarded to the Basel Marriott Hotel. Operating as a white-label hotel operator, MHP establishes strong partnerships with major hotel brands and property owners, emphasizing transparent communication and long-term relationships. Its impressive portfolio features notable properties such as Le Méridien in various cities, the JW Marriott in Frankfurt, and the upcoming Conrad Hamburg, catering to both business and leisure travelers in prime urban locations. MHP Hotel AG's mission is encapsulated in its motto "You Matter," highlighting the significance of guests, employees, and investors in creating a positive and inclusive hospitality experience. The company is a prominent player in the hospitality industry, managing operations across key cities in Germany and Austria, including Hamburg, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, Stuttgart, Munich, and Vienna. MHP is committed to providing exceptional service and crafting memorable experiences for its guests, reflecting its mission to enhance the quality of hospitality. By collaborating with a diverse range of partners and clients, MHP focuses on meeting the evolving needs of modern travelers, whether they are on leisure or business trips. With a strong commitment to excellence and innovation, MHP Hotel AG strives to be a leader in the hotel sector, ensuring that each property under its management adheres to the highest standards of comfort and service.

Name: Hotel Bayerischer Hof München
Company description: Hotel Bayerischer Hof München is a prestigious luxury hotel situated in the heart of Munich, celebrated for its exceptional hospitality and commitment to creating magical moments for its guests. With a rich history that seamlessly blends tradition with modernity, the hotel continuously evolves to offer new highlights, including exquisite dining options and elegantly designed accommodations, such as newly developed suites. The hotel's mission is to provide exceptional service and a unique atmosphere, particularly during festive seasons like Christmas and New Year's Eve, where guests can indulge in gourmet menus and celebratory events. Catering to a diverse clientele, including families, business travelers, and event organizers, Hotel Bayerischer Hof features a variety of venues for private and corporate gatherings. The hotel also partners with local cultural institutions to enhance the guest experience, offering a holistic approach to luxury hospitality. Among its luxurious amenities are the renowned Blue Spa and fine dining restaurants, which aim to provide both relaxation and vibrant city life. The sophisticated beauty center within the hotel offers a range of cosmetic treatments and wellness services, ensuring a rejuvenating experience for all clients. The experienced team at the beauty center is dedicated to personalized care and indulgence, further enhancing the overall guest experience. Hotel Bayerischer Hof München targets discerning guests seeking luxury accommodations, fine dining, and exclusive wellness experiences in a historic and elegant setting, making it a premier destination in Munich.

Name: Deutsche Hospitality
Company description: Deutsche Hospitality stands for an exceptional portfolio comprising more than 130 hotels in 20 countries on three continents, about 30 hotels are currently under development. Deutsche Hospitality stands for an exceptional portfolio comprising more than 130 hotels in 20 countries on three continents, about 30 hotels are currently under development. The unique and varied Deutsche Hospitality portfolio includes Steigenberger Porsche Design Hotels, Steigenberger ICONs, Steigenberger Hotels & Resorts, MAXX by Deutsche Hospitality, our lifestyle option, Jaz in the City, the IntercityHotels at busy hubs such as railway stations and airports and the Zleep Hotels with quality and design at an affordable price.

Name: Motel One Group
Company description: Motel One Group is a leading budget design hotel chain that operates over 95 hotels across 13 countries, primarily in major European cities. The company is known for its modern design, high service standards, and prime urban locations, offering guests a comfortable and stylish stay at competitive prices. With a mission to create a welcoming environment that feels like a home away from home, Motel One emphasizes appreciation, openness, and teamwork among its staff, fostering a strong sense of community. The target market includes both business and leisure travelers seeking quality accommodations without the high price tag, and the company is committed to sustainability, utilizing eco-friendly practices in its operations. As a pioneer in the budget design hotel concept, Motel One continues to expand its footprint, providing numerous career opportunities for ambitious individuals in the hospitality industry.

Name: Victor's Group
Company description: Wir sind Gastgeber und Allesgeber. Helfende Hand mit offenem Ohr. Feinschmecker und Entdecker. Pfleger und Verleger. Wir sind groß, erfahren und international. In unserem Mittelpunkt steht immer der Mensch. Mit dem großen Ziel, Menschen durch besten Service mehr Lebensqualität zu bieten, eröffnete Hartmut Ostermann im Jahr 1977 seine erste Seniorenresidenz – und legte damit den Grundstein für die Victor’s Group, die heute vorrangig in drei großen Geschäftsfeldern tätig ist. Pflege und medizinische Dienstleistungen: Die Victor’s Group betreibt unter den Marken Pro Seniore, Residenz Ambiente, SenVital, Best Care und weiteren Einzelmarken deutschlandweit über 120 Einrichtungen im Gesundheitswesen. Damit zählt sie zu den größten Anbietern von Pflege- und Wohneinrichtungen in Deutschland. Hotellerie und Gastronomie: In Deutschland sprechen 14 Victor’s Residenz-Hotels sowohl Freizeit- als auch Businessgäste an. Nahe Lissabon betreibt Victor’s die Ferienhausanlage Victor’s Portugal Malveira-Guincho. Catering und Gebäudemanagement: Victor’s Health Care wurde 1990 in Mannheim gegründet und ist seitdem bundesweit als Spezialist für Catering und Service im Gesundheits- und Sozialbereich im Einsatz. All das ist natürlich nur mit kompetenten, motivierten Menschen möglich: In der Victor’s Group sind rund 12.500 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter beschäftigt – Tendenz steigend. Mit mehreren unternehmenseigenen Fachschulen sowie lebendigen Aus- und Weiterbildungssystemen investiert Victor’s permanent in neue Fach- und Führungskräfte, bietet aber auch langjährigen Mitarbeitern beste Aufstiegschancen. Alle Mitarbeiter der Victor’s Group profitieren zudem von attraktiven Vorteilen, zum Beispiel von ganzjährigen Rabatten in allen Victor’s Residenz-Hotels und der Ferienhausanlage Victor’s Portugal Malveira-Guincho sowie Vergünstigungen in zahlreichen bekannten Onlineshops.

Name: Trivago NV
Company description: trivago NV is a holding company, which engages in the provision of a global hotel and accommodation search platform. The company is headquartered in Dusseldorf, Nordrhein-Westfalen and currently employs 668 full-time employees. The company went IPO on 2016-12-16. The firm and its subsidiaries offer online meta-search for hotel and accommodation through online travel agencies (OTAs), hotel chains and independent hotels. The firm is focused on focused on reshaping the way travelers search for and compare hotels while enabling hotel advertisers to grow their businesses by providing access to a broad audience of travelers through the Company's websites and apps. The platform allows travelers to make informed decisions by personalizing their hotel search and providing access to a deep supply of hotel information and prices. The firm operates in three operating segments namely the Americas, Developed Europe and the Rest of the World. The firm offer marketing tools to help promote their listings on platform and drive traffic to their websites. The tools and services, including the subscription-based trivago Business Studio Pro Apps Package.

Name: NOVUM Hospitality
Company description: NOVUM Hospitality is one of Europe's largest family-owned hotel groups, operating over 150 hotels across more than 60 locations. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Hamburg, the company has established itself as a key player in the midscale and upper midscale hotel segments, known for its diverse range of centrally located accommodations. With a mission to provide exceptional hospitality experiences, NOVUM Hospitality emphasizes community engagement and sustainability, aiming to create a welcoming environment for all guests. The company has recently entered a strategic partnership with IHG Hotels & Resorts, positioning itself as a major global franchise partner and launching the innovative co-brand Holiday Inn – the niu. This collaboration enhances NOVUM's offerings, allowing it to cater to a broader audience, including business and leisure travelers seeking modern, locally inspired hotel experiences.

Name: GCH Hotel Group
Company description: GCH Hotel Group is a leading hotel management company in Europe, operating over 80 hotels in Germany and Austria, with an additional 40 properties across Europe, totaling more than 15,000 rooms and serving over 3 million guests annually. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional hospitality through a centralized professional management approach, allowing individual hotels to focus on delivering outstanding guest experiences. GCH Hotel Group's mission is encapsulated in their motto "Let’s Grow, Create, Host," emphasizing their commitment to growth, creativity, and responsibility. Their target market includes business travelers, families, and event organizers, with properties like the Wyndham Hannover Atrium offering extensive amenities such as meeting rooms, fitness facilities, and award-winning dining options. The company values trust, engagement, and flexibility, striving to be the most valuable hotel management entity in Europe.

Name: Maritim Hotelgesellschaft MbH
Company description: Maritim Hotelgesellschaft mbH is one of the largest owner-managed hotel chains in Germany, with a diverse portfolio of hotels spanning seven countries, including Mauritius, Egypt, Malta, Albania, Bulgaria, Italy, and China. Established in 1846, the company has built a reputation for providing exceptional hospitality experiences that blend modern amenities with timeless elegance. Maritim is dedicated to enhancing guest satisfaction through a strong focus on high service quality, innovative digital solutions, and sustainable practices. The company's mission is to create a welcoming environment for both business and leisure travelers, ensuring that every guest enjoys a memorable stay. Maritim caters to a wide range of clients, from individual travelers seeking comfort to corporate groups in need of comprehensive conference facilities. The company partners with local businesses to promote regional tourism, further enriching the guest experience and supporting community engagement. With a commitment to sustainability, Maritim actively invests in initiatives such as e-charging stations and eco-friendly practices, aiming to minimize its environmental impact while maintaining high standards of service. The company's vision includes expanding its international presence while upholding its core values of quality, hospitality, and community involvement. By continuously improving service quality and operational efficiency, Maritim Hotelgesellschaft mbH strives to remain a leading player in the hospitality industry, ensuring that all guests receive exceptional service and a comfortable, enjoyable experience.

Name: Meeting Point Hotels
Company description: Meeting Point Hotels is a prominent hotel management company that operates a diverse portfolio of properties across various destinations, including Spain, Greece, and Italy. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional hospitality experiences, focusing on comfort, quality, and sustainability. With a mission to redefine the art of hospitality, Meeting Point Hotels aims to create memorable stays for families, couples, and solo travelers alike. Their target market includes leisure travelers seeking relaxation and adventure in picturesque locations. The company collaborates with various partners, including travel agencies and local businesses, to enhance guest experiences and promote regional tourism. Through continuous innovation and a commitment to customer satisfaction, Meeting Point Hotels strives to be a leader in the hospitality industry.

Name: Lindner Hotel Group
HQ Location: Germany, North Rhine-westphalia, Düsseldorf, 20 Emanuel-leutze Straße, 40547
Company description: Die Lindner Hotels AG wurde 1973 in Düsseldorf von Diplom-Ingenieur und Architekt Otto Lindner gegründet. Die AG ist die Muttergesellschaft der Lindner Hotel Group und beschäftigt selbst derzeit knapp 850 Mitarbeitende. Die Lindner Hotel Group hat ihre Präsenz im Markt mit vier Marken klar strukturiert: Lindner Hotels & Resorts im oberen Mittelklassesegment, die luxuriösen 7Pines Hotels & Resorts, die urbanen Lifestyle-Boutique-Hotels, die unter der Marke Me and All von Hyatt betrieben werden, und die L-Collection, eine Kollektion exklusiver internationaler Destinationen. Von den insgesamt 35 Hotels der restrukturierten Lindner Hotel Group betreibt die Lindner Hotels AG neun Hotels an sieben Standorten. Die Hotelstandorte der ‚LHG Lifestyle Hotels GmbH (Me and All)‘, der ‚7Pines‘ und ‚L Collection‘ in Deutschland, Europa und eines in den USA waren von dem für die Lindner Hotels AG beantragten Verfahren nicht unmittelbar betroffen. Ebenso wenig die in Realisierung befindlichen ‚Me and All‘-Projekte der LHG Lifestyle Hotels GmbH. Adrian Lindner (CEO), Dr. Christoph Scherk (CFO) bilden den Vorstand der Lindner Hotels AG.

Name: Lindner Hotels & Resorts | Part Of JdV By Hyatt
Company description: Founded by Otto Lindner in Düsseldorf in the 1970s, the Lindner Hotels & Resorts brand embodies timeless values. As a family-owned business, we honour the spirit of our founder, guiding decisions for future generations. Navigating the evolving hospitality industry, we've maintained Lindner's values while strategically rebranding for new segments and global markets. Dedicated to innovation, we've revitalised the brand, preserving its essence amidst growth. Ready to share our journey, rooted in tradition yet forward thinking!

Name: Premier Inn Deutschland
Company description: Premier Inn Deutschland, a subsidiary of the British Whitbread Group, is a rapidly growing hotel chain specializing in the premium economy segment. With its first hotel opening in Rosenheim and a total of 60 locations across Germany, the company aims to become the number one player in this market segment. Premier Inn provides guests with comfortable accommodations featuring modern amenities and a high level of hospitality, supported by an international team. The hotels are strategically located in central areas, making them ideal for both business travelers and tourists.  The company is committed to community engagement, actively supporting local initiatives such as collaborations with the children's charity Children for a Better World e.V. Premier Inn's target audience includes both transient travelers and vacationers looking to explore Germany's cultural and natural attractions. The hotel chain is known for offering affordable and comfortable lodging in various cities, with a mission to ensure a restful stay through high-quality services and amenities in a welcoming environment.  Focusing on family-friendliness, Premier Inn offers special deals where children under 16 can stay and eat breakfast for free. The clientele encompasses both business professionals and leisure travelers seeking central locations and good value for money. By partnering with local organizers and tourism organizations, Premier Inn enhances guest experiences, often integrating cultural events such as musicals and city tours. The company is dedicated to expanding its presence in key urban areas, catering to a diverse clientele that includes international tourists and families, while continuously innovating to meet the evolving needs of its guests.

Name: Living Hotels
Company description: Living Hotels – Apartments in hotels // Home away from home Whether for business or pleasure, Living Hotels are your temporary home away from home. Besides cozy hotel rooms we also offer you affordable serviced apartments: comfortably furnished with complete kitchen or kitchenette, separate living and working area, state-of-the-art business technology, WLAN access and individual round-the-clock service. And by the way: It´s getting cheaper, the longer you stay!  As we are a family-owned, medium-sized business, one thing is very important to us: We are cordial and individual and want our employees and guests to feel comfortable with us. We cater for personal issues and desires with passion and commitment and try to be close to the people as a host AND employer. For the unique feeling to have found a second home. Our history of success started in 1982. Today, we are market leaders in the area of serviced apartments in German-speaking countries and offer around 3,000 rooms in 17 different Living Hotels to business and private travelers – of course always in an excellent location. Visit us in Berlin, Bonn, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt / Main, Munich, Nuremberg, Weimar or Vienna. We are looking forward to meeting you there! Follow this link to see our imprint: https://www.living-hotels.com/en/imprint/

Name: AHORN Hotels & Resorts
Company description: AHORN Hotels & Resorts is a prominent family-run hotel group based in Berlin, operating seven vacation hotels across Germany, primarily in scenic natural landscapes such as the Erzgebirge, Thüringer Wald, Uckermark, and Harz. With a focus on family and active vacations, the company offers a range of accommodations in the 3-star superior and 4-star categories, totaling 2,389 rooms. AHORN's mission emphasizes creating a positive work environment and fostering employee development, which is reflected in their high employee satisfaction ratings and commitment to training young talents. The company targets families and active travelers, providing diverse leisure and dining options to enhance guest experiences. Additionally, AHORN Hotels & Resorts is dedicated to maintaining strong partnerships and a supportive community for both employees and guests, ensuring a welcoming atmosphere for all.

Name: Motel One Germany Betriebs GmbH
Company description: The Munich-based company was founded in 2000 and currently operates over 90 hotels in 12 countries. Motel One offers a unique combination of high-quality interiors, exclusive design, excellent service and outstanding city centre locations at attractive prices. As the creator and a champion of the budget design concept, we believe in evolving continuously rather than resting on our laurels. We embrace our social responsibility, encourage and support our employees, give them a stake in the company’s success with attractive incentives, and do our bit towards social integration. We are warm hosts and committed to sustainable development. We strive to maintain high levels of satisfaction among our staff and our guests. These things provide a solid basis for the successful evolution of Motel One in major cities in Germany and abroad.

Name: Dorint Hotels Betriebs GmbH
Company description: Dorint Hotels Betriebs GmbH is a prominent player in the hospitality industry, specializing in the operation and management of luxury hotels across Germany, including the esteemed Maison Messmer in Baden-Baden. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional guest experiences by blending modern luxury with traditional hospitality, creating a welcoming atmosphere that feels like a home away from home. With a strong emphasis on high-quality service, Dorint Hotels caters to a diverse clientele, including leisure travelers, business professionals, and event organizers. The company offers tailored services such as gourmet dining, wellness facilities, and exclusive event spaces, ensuring that every guest's needs are met. Dorint Hotels is committed to wellness and relaxation, featuring amenities like thermal baths and various sauna experiences that appeal to both leisure travelers and business clients. Their mission is to create memorable moments for guests, whether through family celebrations or corporate events, supported by state-of-the-art conference facilities. The company partners with local businesses and cultural institutions to enhance the guest experience and promote the unique charm of each location, fostering a sense of community engagement. Dorint Hotels envisions itself as a leader in the luxury hotel market, with a commitment to sustainability and responsible tourism. By focusing on innovative offerings and exceptional service, Dorint Hotels aims to ensure that every guest leaves with unforgettable memories, solidifying its reputation as a premier choice in the hospitality sector.

Name: Oetker Hotels
Company description: Oetker Hotels are true masterpieces located in the world’s most desirable destinations. Each property is a landmark and a timeless icon of elegance. With deep devotion to local culture and community, our Hosts of Choice preserve a tradition of legendary European hospitality and genuine family spirit that began in 1872. The collection includes L’Apogée Courchevel, Le Bristol Paris, Brenners Park-Hotel & Spa in Baden-Baden, Hôtel du Cap-Eden-Roc in Antibes, Château Saint-Martin & Spa in Vence, The Lanesborough in London, Eden Rock-St Barths, Jumby Bay Island in Antigua, Palácio Tangará in São Paulo, Hotel La Palma in Capri, The Vineta Hotel in Palm Beach (2025), and more than 150 private villas around the globe. In 2027, a new masterpiece will be opening in Saint-Tropez.

Name: Pentahotels
Company description: Hey! We are Penta, your lively neighborhood hotel. We make no distinction between leisure and business travellers, and our friendly and laid-back approach starts from the check-in at the bar.  Over 20 hotels across Europe, each one gravitating around our hallmark Pentalounge: a combination of lounge, bar, café and reception – your new living room, with standout interior design. You are who you meet, so, get travelling.

Name: Flemings Hotels
HQ Location: Germany, Hesse, Frankfurt Am Main, 52 Bleichstraße, 60313
Company description: Die Flemings Hotels sind ein einzigartiges Sortiment individueller Hotels in Familienbesitz mit Firmensitz in Frankfurt am Main. Zur Flemings Hotels GmbH & Co. KG gehören insgesamt 7 Mid- und Upscale-Hotels: 6 zentral gelegene Cityhotels in Frankfurt, München und Wien sowie ein Franchisebetrieb der Intercityhotel GmbH in Bremen. Unsere Hotels bieten eine perfekte Kombination aus modernem Komfort und zeitgemäßem Design. Jedes Hotel überzeugt mit seinem Boutique at Heart-Ansatz durch individuelle Zimmer, die mit hochwertigen Annehmlichkeiten ausgestattet sind und sowohl Geschäftsreisende als auch Städtereisende ansprechen. Mit unseren flexiblen Tagungsmöglichkeiten, moderner Technik und Inhouse-Restaurants sind wir der ideale Partner für große und kleine Veranstaltungen. Unsere „People makes places“-Philosophie spiegelt dabei unsere Leidenschaft wider, auf die Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste einzugehen und ihnen Flemings Moments zu bescheren.

Company description: We believe that a hotel should be more than just a bed for the night. Where you stay when you’re away from home should be stylish and inspiring. Somewhere characterful and charming, with the flexibility to hit the town or settle in for an evening. ✨ When it comes to where you work, we think it should be just as inspiring. Places with personality and soul, that bring new ideas to life and brighten your workday. ❤️ Since launching in 2013, we’ve opened 17 hotels and 5 workspaces across Europe, and there are 19 more on the horizon. Name: MEININGER Hotels
Company description: MEININGER Hotels is a dynamic hotel chain that merges the comfort of traditional hotels with the vibrant atmosphere of hostels, catering to a diverse range of travelers. Founded in Berlin in 1999, the company has grown to operate over 36 properties across 26 cities in 10 European countries, providing budget-friendly accommodations in prime urban locations. MEININGER's mission is to offer accessible and affordable comfort while fostering local identities and promoting sustainability. The hotels are designed to create a welcoming environment for everyone, from backpackers and families to business travelers, encouraging social interaction and community building. With a focus on flexibility, MEININGER provides a variety of room types, including private rooms and shared dormitories, making it ideal for educational groups, leisure guests, and corporate travelers alike. The company emphasizes modern amenities such as guest kitchens, game zones, and work-friendly public areas, ensuring that both short stays and extended visits are enjoyable. MEININGER's vision is to enhance the travel experience by not only providing a place to stay but also creating a vibrant community space that encourages guest interaction. Committed to sustainability and corporate social responsibility, MEININGER actively engages in projects that promote environmental and social well-being. The company aims to expand its portfolio to 22,000 beds by 2024, supported by strategic partnerships and a dedicated team focused on enhancing the guest experience. By collaborating with local businesses and attractions, MEININGER enriches the travel experience, allowing guests to immerse themselves in the local culture. Overall, MEININGER Hotels stands out as a preferred choice for budget-conscious travelers seeking both comfort and community during their adventures.

Name: Success Hotel Group
Company description: The Success Hotel Management GmbH (SHM) is a family-run hotel company in its second generation. As a licensed partner of international hotel companies, SHM manages a strong multi-brand portfolio throughout Germany as a franchisee. Please find an overview of all hotels at http://www.shgr.com/hotels. The innovation drive of the hotel operating company is reflected in contemporary solutions that have their roots in the traditional hotel industry and grow in the long term with the help of modern technologies and approaches. Examples include the implementation of hotel plans in virtual reality for interactive brand experiences as well as the integration of intelligent technologies for sustainable resource conservation.

Name: The Chocolate On The Pillow Group
Company description: The Chocolate On The Pillow Group operates a collection of modern business and leisure hotels across nine locations in Germany, including GHOTEL hotel & living and nestor Hotel. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional service and creating a home-like atmosphere for both business and leisure travelers, ensuring successful meetings and enjoyable stays. Their mission emphasizes outstanding service orientation and friendliness, which is reflected in numerous positive guest reviews. The target market includes both corporate clients and private travelers seeking comfortable accommodations with ideal amenities for relaxation and productivity. Through strategic partnerships and a commitment to quality, The Chocolate On The Pillow Group aims to enhance the travel experience for its guests.

Name: ACHAT Hotels
Company description: ACHAT Hotels is a dynamic hotel chain headquartered in Mannheim, Germany, boasting over 50 unique properties across Germany and one in Budapest. The company is dedicated to delivering exceptional hospitality, ensuring that every guest feels happy and welcomed during their stay. With a mission centered on providing personalized experiences, ACHAT Hotels places significant emphasis on guest feedback to continuously enhance its services. The hotel chain caters to a diverse clientele, including business travelers, leisure guests, families, and tourists, offering a range of accommodations from three to four-star superior options. ACHAT Hotels is committed to sustainability and diversity, actively training young talents from various backgrounds within the hospitality industry. The company envisions creating a warm, family-like atmosphere where both guests and employees can thrive and feel valued. This vision aligns with their goal of continuous growth and expansion, with plans to open additional hotels in the near future. The hotels are strategically located near major attractions and business hubs, making them ideal for both short getaways and extended stays. In addition to providing comfortable accommodations, ACHAT Hotels partners with local businesses to enhance the guest experience, ensuring that visitors can enjoy the best of the local culture and amenities. The chain's commitment to hospitality and guest satisfaction positions it as a prominent player in the German hotel market, dedicated to creating a welcoming environment where guests can relax and feel at home.

Name: Eurest - Teil Der Compass Group DE
Company description: Eurest steht für skalierbare Betriebsgastronomie für Catering, das durch optimale Anpassungsfähigkeit überzeugt. Was uns auszeichnet: ◽ Exzellente Kulinarik in Deutschlands bestem skalierbaren Menüplan in standardisierten Qualitätsstufen – immer mit Fokus auf ein optimales Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis ◽ Große Auswahl an flexiblen Modulen und Konzepten für individuelle Kunden- und Gastbedürfnisse ◽ Verlässlichkeit und internationales Know-how bei gleichzeitig lokaler Expertise und Betreuung ◽ Professionelle Teams vor Ort, bestehend  aus unterschiedlichen Expertisen. Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung durch unsere zentralen Compass Schulungsprogramme ◽ New Work: Strategische Partnerschaft über das Catering hinaus - Unsere Lösungen unterstützen moderne Arbeitswelten und fördern so das Wohlbefinden der Mitarbeitenden Unser Angebot: Vielfältige Verpflegungslösungen, die passgenau auf die Bedürfnisse der Kunden und Gäste abgestimmt werden können: ◽ Betriebscatering ◽ Event- und Konferenzservice  ◽ Kaffeekonzept und Bäckereikonzept ◽ 24/7 Verpflegung, Vending und Teeküchenbetreuung

Name: DSR Hotel Holding GmbH
Company description: Die DSR Hotel Holding ist Betreiber von derzeit 32 Hotels und Resorts innerhalb fünf wachstumsorientierter Hotel- und Resortmarken sowie zwei traditionsreichen Einzelhotels. Als mittelständisches Unternehmen mit starken Gesellschaftern vereint die DSR Hotel Holding langjährige Erfahrung und Know-how innerhalb des Tourismussektors mit Innovation, agilen Praktiken und ganzheitlichem sowie nachhaltigem unternehmerischen Handeln.

Name: Precise Hotels And Resorts
Company description: Precise collection of selected hotels and resorts captures the best of all worlds. It offers extraordinary experiences in inspiring locations, while remaining inherently bound to the traditional values of hospitality. Set in locations of great beauty all Precise creations have a story to tell … PRECISE RESORTS - HOLIDAY FOR ALL Set against the backdrop of the most stunning natural landscapes, Precise Resorts are an oasis, a centre of wellbeing and indulgence for couples and families. PRECISE TALES - LEGENDARY LUXURY The exclusive Precise Tales collection of 5-star hotels allows guests to relax, unwind and getaway in style, far from the madding crowd. PRECISE HOUSES - BUSINESS MEETS LEISURE Precise Houses is a fresh and innovative brand of 4-star urban properties that combines stylish design and approachable service at affordable rates.

Name: Arabella Hospitality SE
Company description: Arabella Hospitality SE is a leading player in the hospitality investment sector, offering a comprehensive range of services for hotel operations and development. The company operates as an owner, lessee, developer, and operator of hotels located in prime locations, ensuring a high standard of service and guest experience. Committed to responsible and sustainable business practices, Arabella Hospitality emphasizes integrity, transparency, and fairness in all its dealings with clients, partners, and stakeholders. The company’s mission is to uphold the highest ethical standards while fostering a culture of compliance and respect for human rights throughout its operations. Arabella Hospitality serves a diverse clientele, including hotel developers, investors, and business partners, and aims to build long-lasting relationships based on mutual trust and shared values.

Name: AMANO Group
Company description: AMANO Group is a dynamic hospitality company that operates a diverse portfolio of hotels, restaurants, and bars across major cities in Germany and London, including Berlin, Munich, Leipzig, and Düsseldorf. The company is dedicated to providing exceptional experiences for both travelers and locals, with a focus on stylish accommodations and vibrant nightlife. AMANO Group's mission is to create unique and memorable environments that blend comfort with metropolitan flair, catering to a wide range of clients from business travelers to leisure seekers. Their venues, such as the AMANO Rooftop Bars and various restaurants, are designed to foster social interactions and celebrate local culture. With a commitment to sustainability and community engagement, AMANO Group aims to be a leader in the hospitality industry while enhancing the guest experience through innovative services and partnerships.

Name: Grecos Holiday
Company description: Jesteśmy jednym z 5 największych touroperatorów w Polsce, z siedzibą w Poznaniu. Spółka założona została w 2005 roku.  W skład Zarządu wchodzą Alicja Skoczyńska, Wojciech Skoczyński i Janusz Śmigielski. Nasz zespół to ponad 250 osób zatrudnionych w Polsce, w Grecji i na Cyprze. Dzięki naszemu wieloletniemu doświadczeniu w organizacji Wielkich Greckich Wakacji dajemy naszym Klientom wspaniałe wspomnienia, zapewniamy najwyższą jakość usług, bezpieczeństwo i doskonałą zabawę. Nasz zespół to pasjonaci Grecji, którzy doskonale znają jej kulturę, krajobrazy i możliwości, co pozwala nam oferować wyjątkowe doświadczenia wakacyjne.  W każdym obiekcie zapewniamy opiekę rezydentów i pilotów, atrakcyjne i wyjątkowe wycieczki lokalne, pozwalające na odkrywanie Grecji oraz wyjątkowe Kluby Animacyjne — „Zorba”, „Delfinki” i „Opa! Grecos” zapewniające dobrą zabawę i organizację czasu wakacji Klientom z każdej grupy wiekowej.

Name: Estrel Berlin
Company description: Estrel Berlin is Europe's largest hotel, congress, and entertainment center, featuring 1,125 rooms and suites, four restaurants, and three bars. The venue is renowned for hosting Berlin's most successful live show, "Stars in Concert," which celebrates iconic artists through captivating performances. With a mission to provide exceptional hospitality and entertainment experiences, Estrel Berlin caters to a diverse clientele, including international tourists, business travelers, and event organizers. The Estrel Congress Center offers versatile spaces for conferences, exhibitions, and special events, making it a preferred choice for corporate partners and event planners. The company is committed to fostering a family-like work environment, emphasizing employee development and satisfaction, while continuously enhancing its service offerings to meet the evolving needs of its guests.

Name: Victor's Residenz-Hotels
Company description: Erfolgreicher & entspannter tagen – das versprechen die 12 deutschen Victor’s Residenz-Hotels. Ob in der Großstadt oder im Grünen, ob kleines Meeting oder große Autopräsentation, bei Victor’s finden Sie ideale Voraussetzungen für erfolgreiche Business-Treffen. Und die entspanntesten Gäste. Nach der Arbeit erwarten Sie komfortable Zimmer, Wellness und vielfältige Gastronomie bis hin zur Sterneküche. Neuerdings können Sie auch ganz entspannt von unterwegs buchen: Gehen Sie einfach mit Ihrem Smartphone auf www.victors.de oder laden Sie die kostenlose Victor’s App für iPhone. Das Victor’s Team freut sich schon auf Ihren Besuch – online und persönlich.

Name: Roomers Hotels
HQ Location: Germany, Hesse, Frankfurt Am Main, 63 Niddastraße, 60329
Company description: Roomers is a place of exciting elegance. Spend a stimulating and extravagant night in our hotels that you will always remember. Or many nights. Experience stylish design, passionate hosts and the personal Roomers vibe that makes every visit a unique experience. The Roomers brand, which is part of the Gekko Group, was founded by the two passionate hoteliers and trendsetters Micky Rosen and Alex Urseanu. "Micky Rosen and Alex Urseanu show how luxury can be interpreted in a modern way, without losing the lightness of being, combining hotel business with impressive bar concepts and innovative gastronomy, creating inspirational meeting spots as you can find them in the larger cities of the world."

Name: Hommage Luxury Hotels Collection
HQ Location: Germany, North Rhine-westphalia, Köln, 1051 Aachener Straße, 50858
Company description: Discover the spirit of our Hommage Luxury Hotels Collection, an association of individual five-star hotels, each rooted in its specific location, treasuring its own personality and style.  We spoil our guests with heartfelt hospitality and utmost convenience. We offer unique experiences that come to life through the interaction of contemporary luxury, the passion of our dedicated team and the beautiful features of the specific location: moments that make memories. Independently lead under the umbrella of the Dorint Group, we offer employees the best working conditions in a premium environment, an above-average salary, extra benefits, attractive promotion prospects and the fair work–life balance of a modern employer.  We offer interns and apprentices training with an interesting and varied scope of work and the best opportunities for a good start in their career. We offer business partners an open mind for innovative types of collaboration.   Learn more about the Hommage Luxury Hotels Collection  on our website and also visit the the focus pages of our destinations in Germany and Austria: - Söl’ring Hof (Sylt) - Parkhotel (Bremen) - Hotel Kö59 (Düsseldorf) - Hotel Nassauer Hof (Wiesbaden) - Maison Messmer (Baden-Baden) - Grand Tirolia (Kitzbühel)

Name: Seaside Collection
Company description: The Seaside Collection Hotel Group comprises of in total 12 exclusive resort and city hotels: in Gran Canaria, Lanzarote and the Maldives and six city hotels in Hamburg, Leipzig, Dresden, St. Peter Ording and Chemnitz. All of the Seaside establishments are acclaimed for their privileged locations, personal service and exclusive gastronomy together with unique architecture and distinctive design concepts. The group was founded in the Canary Islands over 30 years ago by Theo Gerlach, who at the age of 90 years continues personally at the helm of his hotels. In 1997, his son Gregor Gerlach assumed responsibility for the German division of the group. And for some years his daughter Anouchka Gerlach is responsible together with her father for the Spanish division of the group. The group is highly acclaimed as setting the benchmark for hotel gastronomy. In addition to the hospitality industry, the Seaside Collection Hotel Group is active in construction and gastronomy.  Seaside Collection is recognized for its values as a business that strives to provide longevity for employees and their commitments to sustainable tourism. Theo Gerlach firmly believes that sustainable development will permit tourism to be the driving force behind economic prosperity. The ongoing initiatives in each individual hotel encompass these principles and remain his legacy to future generations.  Investment plans incorporate refurbishments to maintain the hotels at an optimal standard together with the introduction of new sustainability initiatives to ensure a continued reduction in environmental impacts encouraging sustainable development. Innovative future projects ensure a stable model of growth, professionalism and service to their guests.

Name: Metropolregion Rhein-Neckar
Company description: Die Metropolregion Rhein-Neckar GmbH ist eine zentrale Institution, die sich der nachhaltigen Entwicklung und Förderung der Metropolregion Rhein-Neckar widmet. Seit ihrer Gründung im Jahr 2005 hat sie sich zum Ziel gesetzt, die Region durch innovative Projekte und Kooperationen zu stärken und zu gestalten. Ihre Mission umfasst die Förderung von Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft und Kultur sowie die Verbesserung der Lebensqualität für die Bürgerinnen und Bürger. Die Metropolregion arbeitet eng mit einer Vielzahl von Partnern, darunter Kommunen, Unternehmen und Bildungseinrichtungen, zusammen, um gemeinsame Interessen zu identifizieren und regionale Lösungen zu entwickeln. Ihr Ziel ist es, die Region als attraktiven Standort für Unternehmen und Fachkräfte zu positionieren und gleichzeitig ökologische und soziale Nachhaltigkeit zu gewährleisten.

Name: Compass Group Deutschland GmbH
Company description: Compass Group Deutschland GmbH ist ein führendes Dienstleistungsunternehmen im Bereich Catering und Facility Services, das Teil der globalen Compass Group ist. Mit über 14.500 Mitarbeitenden in Deutschland und mehr als 550.000 weltweit, serviert das Unternehmen jährlich über 5 Milliarden Mahlzeiten und betreut täglich rund 213.000 Gäste. Die Mission von Compass Group Deutschland ist es, als Transformationsbegleiter für ihre Kunden zu agieren und einen nachhaltigen Beitrag zur Branche zu leisten, wobei Wertschätzung, Respekt und Teamarbeit zentrale Werte sind. Das Unternehmen bedient eine Vielzahl von Kunden in unterschiedlichen Sektoren und setzt auf kulinarische Vielfalt und Qualität, insbesondere durch ihre hauseigene leonardiManufaktur. Zudem engagiert sich Compass Group Deutschland für Diversität und Inklusion, was sich in der kulturellen Vielfalt ihrer Mitarbeitenden widerspiegelt.

Name: MERKUR SLOTS | The Gauselmann Group
Company description: MERKUR SLOTS opera actualmente salones de juego en Baleares, Cantabria, Madrid y Navarra. Cuenta además con una plantilla de más de 50 trabajadores. El modelo de éxito para todas nuestras salas es la triple armonía entre las máquinas recreativas más modernas, un ambiente de primera clase y trabajadores muy bien cualificados. MERKUR SLOTS es una filial del Grupo Gauselmann, un gigante alemán con 65 años de historia y que cuenta con más de 12.000 trabajadores.

Name: A.R.A. Hotels
Company description: A.R.A. Hotels is a distinguished hospitality company dedicated to providing exceptional lodging experiences tailored to the needs of its guests. With a mission to foster a welcoming environment that prioritizes comfort and service excellence, A.R.A. Hotels aims to create memorable stays for travelers and business professionals alike. The company envisions itself as a leader in the hospitality sector, committed to continuous improvement and innovation in its services. A.R.A. Hotels caters to a diverse clientele, including leisure travelers, corporate guests, and event organizers, while partnering with local businesses to enhance the overall guest experience. Through its focus on community engagement and sustainable practices, A.R.A. Hotels strives to contribute positively to the regions it serves.

Name: RIMC International Hotels & Resorts
Company description: Die RIMC Hotels und Resorts Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Hamburg ist eine der führenden internationalen Hotelgesellschaften. An der Spitze steht Marek N. Riegger, CEO/Chief Executive Officer. In den letzten 30 Jahren hat die RIMC Hotels und Resorts Gruppe 200 Hotelprojekte im In- und Ausland realisiert. Die RIMC Hotels und Resorts Gruppe kann mit ihrer Idee, mit maßgeschneiderten Managementlösungen Hotels betreiben und gegebenenfalls zu revitalisieren, große Erfolge aufweisen.

Company description: Limehome is a leading tech-enabled operator in the hospitality industry offering functional, design accommodations across Europe. Using proprietary technology, Limehome delivers comfortable and convenient stays with a seamless digital guest experience for business and leisure travellers. Our vision is to be the first choice in travel for everyone, everywhere. By now, our portfolio consists of more than 11,000 apartments and hotel rooms under contract across 150 cities in 13 European countries.  This is just the beginning. Stay tuned!

Name: DORMERO Hotels
Company description: DORMERO Hotels is a dynamic hotel group based in Berlin, Germany, known for its innovative and sustainable hospitality offerings. With a growing portfolio of over 50 locations across Germany and expanding into Austria and Spain, DORMERO aims to provide unique and comfortable accommodations that cater to both leisure and business travelers. The company's mission focuses on creating memorable experiences through high-quality service and modern amenities, while its vision emphasizes sustainable development and community engagement. DORMERO's clientele includes a diverse range of guests, from tourists exploring historic cities to business professionals attending conferences, and the company actively seeks partnerships that enhance its brand presence, such as its recent sponsorship with the SCR Altach football club. As it continues to expand, DORMERO is committed to maintaining its reputation for excellence and innovation in the hospitality industry.

Name: Ruf Jugendreisen GmbH & Co. KG
HQ Location: Germany, North Rhine-westphalia, Bielefeld, 11 Am Lenkwerk, 33609
Company description: Wir sind Europas führender Veranstalter für betreute Jugendreisen und seit 44 Jahren erfolgreich unterwegs. Jährlich verreisen 65.000 Gäste zwischen 11 und 23 Jahren mit uns und erleben eine unvergesslich schöne Zeit bei unseren vielfältigen Reisen. Qualität steht bei ruf Jugendreisen dabei traditionell besonders im Fokus. Es ist uns ein zentrales Anliegen und eine Verpflichtung, in jedem Bereich des Unternehmens das Beste für unsere jungen Kunden zu geben. Wesentlichen Anteil an diesem Erfolg haben unsere rund 80 Mitarbeiter:innen in Bielefeld sowie unsere 1.500 haupt- und ehrenamtlichen Reiseleiter:innen an weltweit 80 Urlaubszielen. Jedes Jahr suchen wir Verstärkung und bieten jungen Menschen die Chance, sich persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und dabei eine tolle Zeit mit netten Leuten und an attraktiven Orten zu erleben. Die Ausbildung unserer Reiseleiter:innen erfolgt an der ruf Akademie. Und auch die Firmenzentrale in Bielefeld – das House of ruf – bietet berufliche Perspektiven in den unterschiedlichsten Unternehmensbereichen. Ob Marketing, Personalwesen oder Produktentwicklung - bei uns kann sich jeder verwirklichen. Übrigens: Wir bilden auch aus! Tourismuskaufmann/-frau, Kauffrau/-mann für Marketingkommunikation oder Kaufmann/-frau im E-Commerce. Alle Infos findest du auf https://www.ruf.de/jobs

Name: Andaz Munich Schwabinger Tor
Company description: The luxury lifestyle hotel in Munich for design lovers. Andaz Munich is all about pioneering design, innovative events concepts, and immersive culinary delights for all senses: a meeting place near English Garden for cosmopolitan travelers that inspires creative thoughts and lasting, unscripted memories.  Enjoy alpine views and fresh perspectives of the Olympic Park from the luxurious spa and the city’s highest rooftop bar that will make you feel truly connected to the heart and soul of Munich. Discover fresh perspectives and new opportunities: Whether in the 500 m² ballroom with the adjacent 200 m² exhibition space, or in the seven innovative studios and two private kitchens. The perfect event location for creative minds. Flexible spaces across a total of 2,000 square meters where you can network, collaborate, celebrate, or create something new.

Name: Romantik Hotels & Restaurants AG
Company description: Romantik Hotels & Restaurants AG is a distinguished hospitality company that specializes in providing unique and romantic experiences through its collection of charming hotels and restaurants across Europe. With a mission to create memorable stays that blend comfort, culinary excellence, and local culture, the company aims to offer guests an authentic and personalized experience. The flagship property, Romantik Hotel Castello Seeschloss, is a historic castle located on the shores of Lake Maggiore, known for its luxurious accommodations, exquisite dining options, and stunning views. Catering primarily to couples and travelers seeking a romantic getaway, Romantik Hotels & Restaurants AG partners with local artisans and culinary experts to enhance the guest experience, ensuring that each visit is filled with warmth and hospitality. The company is committed to sustainability and community engagement, making it a preferred choice for discerning travelers looking for both luxury and a sense of place.

Name: PLAZA Hotelgroup GmbH
Company description: PLAZA Hotelgroup GmbH is a dynamic and family-owned hospitality company established in 2002, specializing in the operation of city and business hotels across Germany, Austria, and the Netherlands. With a diverse portfolio of over 50 locations and more than 7,500 rooms, the company caters to both business and leisure travelers through its well-known PLAZA INN brand. PLAZA Hotelgroup is dedicated to providing exceptional guest experiences, focusing on creating a welcoming atmosphere that feels like home. The company's mission is to ensure comfort and convenience for all guests by offering modern, well-equipped accommodations, including fitness areas and conference spaces. Targeting a diverse clientele that includes business professionals, families, and tourists, PLAZA Hotelgroup partners with local attractions and businesses to enhance the overall guest experience. The company emphasizes quality and customer satisfaction, striving to be a preferred choice for travelers seeking comfort and convenience during their journeys. With a commitment to expanding its presence in the hospitality industry, PLAZA Hotelgroup recently opened PLAZA INN Graz, further solidifying its position in both leisure and business markets. Through its focus on exceptional service and long-term relationships with guests and partners, PLAZA Hotelgroup aims to be a leader in the hospitality sector while upholding its family-oriented values.

Name: Sunis Hotels
Company description: Started in 2006, our company serves in the tourism and hotel management sector. In this journey that we started with our first hotel, today we offer unique experiences to our guests with 5 hotels. Locations of our hotels: - Kumkoy, Evrenseki, Kizilagac (Manavgat) - 3 hotels - Konyaalti (Antalya) - 1 hotel - Ozdere (Izmir) - 1 hotel Each of our hotels stands out with its unique concept and features, keeping guest satisfaction at the forefront: - Sunis Hotelsu (Konyaalti, Antalya): Located next to Konyaalti Beach, our hotel is an ideal choice for both holiday and business trips with its city hotel management, resort hotel management and spacious meeting rooms. It offers unforgettable moments with its terrace restaurant and bar overlooking the Mediterranean Sea. - Sunis Evren Beach (Evrenseki, Manavgat): It is an excellent option for those looking for a peaceful holiday with its fine sandy beach and calm atmosphere. - Sunis Kumköy Beach (Kumköy, Manavgat): It attracts attention with its location close to the city centre and historical Side, large garden and pool areas. - Sunis Elita Beach (Kizilagac, Manavgat): It offers a pleasant holiday with the clean waters of the Mediterranean, wide beach and spacious garden. - Sunis Efes Palace (Özdere, Izmir): Our hotel, located on the cool waters of the Aegean Sea, offers a unique holiday experience with its fine sandy beach and pier where fish can be seen. In addition, you can reach the House of Virgin Mary and the Ancient City of Ephesus in just 40 minutes from our hotel.

Name: Gorgeous Smiling Hotels GmbH
Company description: The Gorgeous Smiling Hotels GmbH, based in Munich, acts as the umbrella company for numerous brands and operating companies in the international hospitality industry. Awarded by the Financial Times and Focus Business, the group is among the thousand fastest growing companies in Europe.   Under its roof, GSH coordinates development, yield management, purchasing, sales, marketing, as well as all legal matters.   Global players like IHG, Hilton, and Wyndham are franchise partners of the GSH Group. Their brands are being successfully adapted for the European market by GSH . New construction projects as well as renovations of existing properties are implemented creatively and converted quickly.   The strong expansion of the GSH Group in countries such as Germany, Austria, and Switzerland led to a house volume of over 40 objects in diverse segments.

Name: The Niu Hotels
Company description: The Niu Hotels is a dynamic hotel chain offering a diverse range of accommodations across Germany, the Netherlands, Austria, and the United Kingdom. With a focus on providing exceptional value, the company guarantees the best prices and offers a 10% discount on bookings made through its official website. The Niu Hotels aims to create memorable experiences for a variety of travelers, whether they are seeking adventure with friends and family, a romantic getaway, or a relaxing retreat. The brand emphasizes high safety and hygiene standards, ensuring guests can enjoy their stays with peace of mind. Targeting both leisure and business travelers, The Niu Hotels partners with local attractions and services to enhance the overall guest experience.

Name: Seminaris Hotels
Company description: Seminaris Hotels is a pioneering hotel group in Germany that specializes in providing modern conference and leisure facilities designed to foster sustainable growth and creativity. With a mission centered around "We make people grow," the company emphasizes the importance of employee satisfaction and empowerment as key drivers of its success. Operating a network of strategically located hotels across Germany, Seminaris offers tailored services for conferences, workshops, and retreats, while also catering to leisure travelers seeking relaxation in nature. The company is committed to sustainability, implementing an environmental management system certified under DIN EN ISO 14001:2015, and actively supports the United Nations' 17 Sustainable Development Goals. By fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation, Seminaris Hotels aims to create inspiring environments for both its employees and guests, making it a preferred choice for organizations looking to enhance team dynamics and personal development. The hotels are situated in or near major cities, providing a unique blend of urban accessibility and natural surroundings, ideal for both business travelers and urban explorers. Seminaris collaborates with a network of New Work coaches and experts to offer tailored workshops and training, addressing the evolving needs of the hospitality industry and its clientele. The company focuses on creating sustainable and transformative experiences for its guests and employees, emphasizing a modern corporate culture that values communication, self-determination, and teamwork. Seminaris Hotels provides flexible and hybrid work models, allowing employees to tailor their contracts to fit their lifestyles while actively involving them in the transformation of the organization. Catering primarily to business clients, Seminaris offers attractive deals for meetings, conferences, and corporate events across its various locations in Germany. Committed to social and ecological sustainability, Seminaris ensures a respectful relationship with both people and nature, striving to create an inclusive environment where every employee has a voice and opportunities for development.

Company description: Als 100% Tochtergesellschaft des Bayer Konzerns stehen wir als Gastronomie- & Hospitalitypartner der Bayer AG zur Seite.

Name: MO Den Bosch
Company description: MO Den Bosch is a dedicated organization focused on providing social support and shelter for individuals facing homelessness or at risk of becoming homeless in 's-Hertogenbosch. Their mission is to offer a safe haven, practical assistance, and guidance to help clients achieve a more independent and fulfilling life. With a commitment to community welfare, MO Den Bosch collaborates with various partners, including local municipalities, housing corporations, and other social organizations, to implement innovative solutions like the Housing First approach. Their target market includes vulnerable populations, particularly women and children, who require immediate support and long-term recovery strategies. As a recognized ANBI organization, MO Den Bosch operates without profit motives, ensuring that their efforts are directed towards the greater good of society.

Name: Consortium Gastronomie GmbH
Company description: Einfach richtig gut essen! Und das nicht nur im Restaurant, sondern auch am Arbeitsplatz? Eine simple Idee mit hohem Anspruch: Das ist es, was CONSORTIUM antreibt. Wir kochen Frische – mit regionalen und saisonalen Produkten! Wir sind Partner auf Augenhöhe für unsere Kunden, Gäste, Mitarbeiter, Lieferanten und Landwirte. Individuelle Kundenwünsche zu erfüllen, die Leidenschaft fürs Kochen und der Genuss von gutem Essen zeichnen uns aus.

Name: SIHOT DACH
Company description: SIHOT DACH is a leading provider of event management solutions tailored specifically for the Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Events (MICE) sector within the hospitality industry. The company aims to empower hotels to maximize their MICE business potential by offering innovative tools and services that enhance guest experiences and streamline event operations. With a focus on revenue generation, customer satisfaction, and sustainability, SIHOT DACH supports hotels in adapting to the evolving needs of MICE travelers, who are known to spend significantly more than leisure guests. Their clientele includes hotels and venues looking to improve occupancy rates and enhance their reputation through successful event hosting. By leveraging advanced technology and providing tailored packages, SIHOT DACH helps its partners create memorable experiences that foster repeat business and long-term relationships in the competitive MICE market.

Name: Welcome Hotels
HQ Location: Germany, Hesse, Frankfurt Am Main, 46 Kuhwaldstraße, 60486
Company description: Welcome Hotels is a premier hospitality company in Germany, specializing in providing unique and elegant venues for a variety of events, including weddings, corporate meetings, and private celebrations. With a mission to create unforgettable experiences, Welcome Hotels combines timeless elegance with local charm across its diverse locations, ensuring that every guest feels welcomed and valued. The company offers a range of services, including personalized event planning, comfortable accommodations, and comprehensive training programs for staff development, reflecting its commitment to excellence in service. Targeting both leisure and business travelers, Welcome Hotels partners with local businesses and organizations to enhance the guest experience and foster community engagement. With a focus on quality and customer satisfaction, Welcome Hotels aims to be the preferred choice for memorable events and stays in Germany.

Name: Althoff Grandhotel Schloss Bensberg
Company description: Althoff Grandhotel Schloss Bensberg is a luxurious hotel located in a historic baroque castle near Cologne, offering a unique blend of opulence and modern hospitality. The hotel is part of the Althoff Collection, which is renowned for its commitment to exceptional service and culinary excellence, featuring the two-Michelin-starred restaurant Vendôme led by chef Joachim Wissler. With 111 elegantly appointed rooms, including 35 suites, the hotel caters to both leisure and business travelers, as well as couples seeking a romantic wedding venue. Althoff Grandhotel Schloss Bensberg aims to create unforgettable experiences for its guests, emphasizing personalized service and attention to detail. The hotel collaborates with top-tier partners to ensure that every event, from weddings to corporate gatherings, is executed flawlessly, making it a sought-after destination for those looking to celebrate special moments in a breathtaking setting.

Name: SO/ Berlin Das Stue
Company description: A 5 star superior luxury boutique hotel that feels both distinctly new and unique and at the same time rediscovers some of the best traditions of Berlin's early 20th century social life. SO/ Berlin Das Stue offers a withdrawal into the private while at the same time supporting the pursuit of meaningful encounters and enchanting conversations.   In our restaurants and in the bar we strive to entertain our guests with the highest level of culinary creations and beverage culture.   Extracting the best of the past and present, SO/ Berlin Das Stue creates a deeply personal and truly unique atmosphere of sophistication and style. Here, the tradition of the drawing room, or salon is enriched through meaningful innovation.   We believe in giving more than necessary or expected, be it space or quality, attention or inspiration. We treasure privacy and cherish individuality and yet we love acquainting people, fostering stimulating relationships and building a community.   We also believe that intimacy paired with being illustriously social creates a different kind of business hotel. Because we know that the best business is done after you stop working.

Company description: Le Méridien Hamburg is a distinguished hotel that forms part of The Luxury Collection, renowned for offering authentic and enriching experiences to its guests. With a commitment to personalized and anticipatory service, Le Méridien Hamburg caters to a diverse clientele, including international travelers, business professionals, and local patrons seeking a luxurious escape. The hotel partners with various organizations to enhance guest experiences and is strategically positioned to attract those who appreciate evocative storytelling and cultural immersion. Through its dedication to excellence and a unique blend of historical charm and modern amenities, Le Méridien Hamburg aims to be a premier destination for luxury hospitality in the heart of the city.

Name: Schmidts TIVOLI GmbH
Company description: Eigene Musicalproduktionen, ausgeflippte Revuen und gnadenlose Comedy mitten auf Deutschlands berühmtester Meile, der Reeperbahn – dafür steht der Name Schmidt! Über 400.000 Gäste im Jahr besuchen die drei Hamburger Theater: das 1988 eröffnete Schmidt Theater, das Schmidts Tivoli, das 1991 seinen Spielbetrieb aufnahm, und das jüngste und kleinste Kind der Schmidt-Familie, das 2015 im Klubhaus St. Pauli eröffnete Schmidtchen. Dazu gibt’s das ganze Jahr über Kindertheater für die ganze Familie. Alle drei Bühnen sind Verzehrtheater. Name: Hotel LIBERTY

Die ersten Gefangenen in dieser ehemaligen Justizvollzugsanstalt in Offenburg waren die Visionäre und Vordenker der Freiheit und Demokratie in Deutschland, die badischen Revolutionäre. Liebevoll, behutsam und mit Respekt vor der Geschichte dieses alten Hauses haben wir lange darüber nachgedacht, wie wir es umgestalten und neu nutzen könnten. Mit Begeisterung fürs Detail haben wir diesen massiven Mauern neues Leben eingehaucht, konnten Alt und Neu in wunderbarer Weise verbinden. Von nun an wird dieses kolossale Gebäude mit seinen wuchtigen Fenstern und Türen Ihnen immer offenstehen. Herzlich willkommen im LIBERTY!

Name: Slowness
HQ Location: Germany, Berlin, Berlin, 3 Zur Alten Flussbadeanstalt, 10317
Company description: Slowness is a collective of people, places and projects that reframe the way we live and interact.  In times of great haste, we dare to be slow. Not a mere shift in velocity but an altered state of being. We break cycles of distraction and destruction, opening deep chasms of reflection and space for energetic insight. Slowness defies conventions, embracing the imperfect, the strange and indigenous. Not the prettiest apple but the tastiest, the unaltered, the one that bends the branch. Slowness has been quietly unfolding since the creation in 2016 of La Granja Ibiza. The transformation of a dormant agricultural plot into a working farmstead devoted to discourse around food set the stage for a new kind of hospitality concept. We began to assemble a community of designers, farmers, writers, artists, artisans and architects whose work engages with slowness toward a resetting of values in hospitality and beyond. Cultivating arts, crops and inner gardens, we build and nourish locally rooted places that offer a deeper, more conscious form of hospitality—not a “pit stop” away from the hectic pace of daily life but a continuous journey of reconnection, of learning to live in harmony with nature, our community and ourselves. Drawing on the insights of the slow movement, adaptive reuse, and regenerative agriculture, we take a localized, conscientious approach to every element in the creation of integrated aesthetic environments designed to enrich wellbeing and model a more sustainable future. We draw inspiration from idealistic collectives of the past, like the 1920s experimental Catskills retreat Yama Farms or the legendary avant-garde incubator Black Mountain College, which looked to traditional cultures and crafts as they dreamed up wildly innovative new forms. To be slow is not merely to decrease the pace of life. It’s about taking the time to reconsider our actions and think more deeply and responsibly about how we live.

Name: Burgerlich
Company description: Aus Liebe zum Burger Das Premium-Konzept Burgerlich setzt auf eine stringent durchgehende „Homemade- Philosophie“, hohe Qualität und Frische. Die Burger werden zu 100 Prozent aus qualitativ hochwertigem Rindfleisch regionaler Anbieter hergestellt und jeden Tag frisch zubereitet. Zunächst wird das Fleisch durch den Fleischwolf gedreht, in Kugeln portioniert und erst vor dem Grillen in die flache runde Form (Burger Patty) gebracht. Je nach Wunsch des Gastes wird der Burger auf dem 360 Grad heißen Rost medium oder well done frisch gegrillt. Ganz nach dem Motto „Für jeden Geschmack den richtigen Burger“ gibt es verschiedene Varianten – vom klassischen Burger zum scharfen Chili-Burger bis hin zur vegetarischen Variante. Auch die drei Brötchensorten – Brioche, Sesam und Vollkorn – zwischen denen der Gast frei wählen kann, lassen Freiraum für Vielfalt. Die gemeinsam mit einer Hamburger Bäckerei entwickelten und nach geheimer Rezeptur zubereiteten Brötchen (Burger Buns) werden als rohe Teiglinge geliefert und vor Ort frisch gebacken. In der Verbindung aus heiß gegrilltem und selbstgemachtem Burger Patty, frischen Beilagen und hausgebackenem Brötchen liegt das Geheimnis des Burgers – no ordinary Hamburger.

Name: Relais & Châteaux Gut Steinbach Hotel Chalets SPA
Company description: Das Relais & Châteaux Gut Steinbach Hotel und Chalets ist ein 4 Sterne Superior Hotel in Reit im Winkl im oberbayerischen Chiemgau. Auf 51 Hektar erwartet unsere Gäste ein Stammhaus mit 50 Zimmern und Suiten sowie ein Chaletdorf mit 7 großzügigen Landhaus Chalets. Jedes Chalet verfügt über zwei bis drei Schlafzimmer mit jeweils eigenem Badezimmer. Ein gemeinsamer Wohn- und Essbereich sowie ein privater Wellnessbereich mit Sauna, Ruhebereich und Erlebnisdusche rundet das Erlebnis ab. Im November 2021 eröffnet zudem der neue "Heimat & Natur SPA" auf 2.000qm Innen- und Außenfläche. Gäste dürfen sich unter anderem auf einen 18 Meter Indoorpool, eine Panoramasauna, mehrere Ruheoasen sowie ein breites Angebot an Massagen und Behandlungen freuen. Gut Steinbach eignet sich nicht nur für Entspannung, Sport und Genuss, sondern ist auch hervorragend für kleinere Tagungen sowie Besprechung, die ein hohes Maß an Intimität erfordern, geeignet. Neben den Tagungsräumen lassen sich auch die Chalets mit ihrem Dorfcharakter für Meetings nutzen. Außerdem steht mit dem Konzept "Tagen im Wald" das komplette Hotelgrundstück für unsere Gäste bereit.  Auf dem Grundstück leben in der eigenen biozertifizierten Landwirtschaft Yaks, Ziegen, Hühner, Gänse und Hirsche. Reit im Winkl selbst ist das Eldorado des Winter- und Sommersports. Die Langlaufloipe führt direkt an der Hoteltüre von Gut Steinbach vorbei und das Skigebiet Steinplatte ist 10 Minuten entfernt.

Name: Smart Host
Company description: Smart Host was founded 2016 in order to provide hoteliers with the world’s most user-friendly CRM System. Hotels have got pretty out of sync with their guests. In a high-speed digital world, third parties - like online travel agencies - have hijacked those direct interactions that used to go on between hotels and guests. Only thing is, these third parties never meet the guest face-to-face, meaning that customer experience suffers. Hotels, on the other hand, know their guests personally. They get to know how someone likes their coffee, what sports they're into, which spa treatments they enjoy, and how often they go hiking. Smart Host lets hotels use this knowledge in a systematic way. The hotel can re-establish direct interactions, the guest gets a better customer experience, and everyone wins. This process happens completely automatically and in the background. Smart Host uses the most advanced methods of data segmentation, machine learning, artificial intelligence and automatic communication systems. The result is an improved customer experience and communication, which turns into more direct bookings and increased profitability.   Our team is diverse, international and highly motivated. Name: Schloss Lieser Autograph Collection By Marriott
Company description: The story of Schloss Lieser began around 1885 when the castle was built by Eduard Puricelli, a successful entrepreneur, under the architecture of Heinrich Theodor Schmidt. Soon after moving in, Eduard started cultivating vineyards on the surrounding hills to produce and bottle his own wines. The villa was slightly elevated to prevent the ground floor, where the bottling happened, from flooding when the river would burst its banks. Maria Puricelli was the sole heiress of the family’s possessions when her father died. She married the handsome, wealthy Prussian politician Clemens Freiherr von Schorlemer-Lieser, who was part of the cabinet of Kaiser Wilhelm II, the last German Emperor and King of Prussia. At the turn of the century, Maria and Clemens moved into the villa and renovated it into the beautiful castle it is today. Although the original architect had chosen a Neo-Renaissance style and based his design on the Italian Palladian villas of the 16th and 17th centuries, the new additions were Art Nouveau. In 2007 the property was acquired by the present owner, Mr. P. Killaars, who embarked on a wide-ranging program of renovation and expansion during six years (2011-2017), transforming the castle into an extra-special luxury residence. Now Schloss Lieser is still one of the most important buildings in the region. It holds the second place of the German state Rhineland-Palatinate. (The first place is taken by Burg Eltz). And starting from August 2019, Schloss Lieser is ready to welcome visitors from all over the world to share its beautiful history.

Sie sind das Fundament unseres Handelns, Orientierungshilfe in allen Geschäftsentscheidungen und Basis unserer Motivation. Sie sollen sich vor allem in unserem Verhalten untereinander und gegenüber Außenstehenden ausdrücken. Dabei wissen wir, dass Glaube eine persönliche Entscheidung ist und nicht verallgemeinert oder anderen vorgegeben werden kann. Deshalb sind wir im Romantischen Winkel allen Menschen gegenüber aufgeschlossen und leben die Glaubensfreiheit – ganz egal ob bei unseren Gästen oder Mitarbeitern. Die 5 Säulen unsere Philosophie sind unsere Unternehmenswerte: 1. Liebe deinen Nächsten wie dich selbst 2. Gutes bewahren, Neues zulassen 3. Wir stehen dafür ein, was wir tun 4. Führungskräfte mit Freude, Herz und Sachverstand 5. Mut zur Offenheit - Wahrheit schafft Klarheit Hotel mit Herz und Charakter. Nach diesem Leitbild arbeiten wir alle im Romantischen Winkel. Jeder Einzelne hat es für sich verinnerlicht und handelt danach. Nur so schaffen wir eine offene Arbeitsatmosphäre, in der sich auch wirklich jeder wohlfühlt. So können wir unserer Arbeit mit Spaß und Motivation nachgehen.

Name: Strandhotels Fischland & Dünenmeer
Company description: MEIN ZUHAUSE AN DER OSTSEE Wir haben das Anliegen, Menschen mit einem ganzheitlichen Programm auf ihrer Reise zu sich selbst zu begleiten. Dabei darf jede*r den Weg und das Tempo selbst wählen, entsprechend breit gefächert ist das ganzheitlich gedachte Angebot. Der Ort dafür ist perfekt: mit einer Natur, deren Ursprünglichkeit die Energien zum Fließen bringt, mit einer erlebnisreichen Sportwelt und einem Füllhorn an Wellbeing- und Beauty-Treatments, die Ihren Akku wieder aufladen. Eine tiefgreifende Gesamterfahrung, die gleichzeitig beruhigt und bewegt. Es liegt in der Art der Begegnungen mit diesem Kraftort, an der Schwingung des Gesamten und vor allem an den vielen gastgebenden Persönlichkeiten. Dazu der weiße Strand, das Licht, die Farben, das Meer, die Dünen, der Wald, die Sterne am Himmel und in der Küche. Wir sind nachhaltig, weil wir die Natur intensiv nutzen und täglich erleben dürfen. Wir nennen das ein Holistic Hideaway. EIN FASZINIERENDER ORT FÜR KENNER*INNEN Ein Urlaub oder Kurztrip in der Nebensaison an der Ostsee ist eine echte Bereicherung. Besonders das faszinierende Wintergesicht des Meeres auf der Halbinsel Fischland-Darß-Zingst lässt viele nicht mehr los. Bei „richtig frischen“ Temperaturen bilden sich Eisschollen, schieben sich über- und untereinander, das Meer drückt mit seiner ganzen Kraft dagegen, eigenwillige Gebilde brechen auf und schaffen eine spektakuläre Landschaft. Das Kur- und Bäderwesen der Ostsee nutzt seit mehr als 100 Jahren ionisierende Luft der Brandungszone zur Vorbeugung. Oder sind die Kraniche schon da? Alljährlich kommen bis zu 70.000 Kraniche vorbei und rasten. Ein atemberaubendes Naturschauspiel. Und wenn Sie schon unterwegs sind, hier liegt alles ganz nah beieinander: Strand, Düne, Küstenwald, Bodden und auf der Landzunge Darß-Fischland-Zingst finden Sie viele kleine Inselorte.
